symptoms: Small reddish-brown circular spots with dark borders on leaves
Tiny black pycnidia pimples forming inside leaf spots
Infected grape berries shrivel into hard, black, wrinkled mummies
risk_factors: Warm, humid weather with frequent rain during spring shoot growth
Mummified grapes remaining on the vine from the previous season
prevention: Remove and destroy all dried mummified berry clusters during dormant pruning
Trellis vines to maintain open canopy and rapid drying after dew
recommended_actions: Apply protective mancozeb, captan, or copper sprays from bud break through veraison
